description: This file defines a test fixture class for unit testing the SharedMemoryBuffer component in a media server context. It includes method declarations for testing various buffer operations such as mapping, unmapping, retrieving data offsets, and buffer sizes, specifically for media playback types like audio, video, and web audio. The class is used with Google Test framework and references external classes and methods related to shared memory buffers and media sources.

classes.name: SharedMemoryBufferTests
classes.description: A Google Test fixture class for testing SharedMemoryBuffer functionalities related to media buffer management, including mapping, unmapping, size retrieval, and data access for different media playback types.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture with specified maximum number of playbacks and web audio players.

methods.name: mapPartitionShouldSucceed
methods.description: Tests that mapping a media partition with given playback type and ID succeeds.

methods.name: mapPartitionShouldFail
methods.description: Tests that mapping a media partition with given playback type and ID fails.

methods.name: unmapPartitionShouldSucceed
methods.description: Tests that unmapping a media partition with given playback type and ID succeeds.

methods.name: unmapPartitionShouldFail
methods.description: Tests that unmapping a media partition with given playback type and ID fails.

methods.name: shouldReturnMaxGenericAudioDataLen

methods.name: shouldFailToReturnMaxAudioDataLen
methods.description: Verifies failure to retrieve maximum audio data length for a given playback type and ID.

methods.name: shouldReturnMaxGenericVideoDataLen
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of maximum video data length for a given ID.

methods.name: shouldFailToReturnMaxVideoDataLen

methods.name: shouldReturnMaxWebAudioDataLen

methods.name: shouldFailToReturnAudioDataOffset
